id.description: A unique integer value identifying this dashboard.

widgets.description: Widget tiles to add atomically (1–10). Each entry uses the same fields as a single add request.

config.description: Widget-specific configuration JSON. Shape depends on widget_type; see config_schema_hints in dashboard-widget-catalog-list (currently: error_tracking_list, session_replay_list).

description.description: Optional markdown description shown when show_description is enabled.

layouts.description: Optional react-grid-layout positions keyed by breakpoint (sm, xs).

name.description: Optional custom display name for the widget tile.

show_description.description: Whether to show the description on the dashboard tile.

widget_type.description: Widget type identifier. Supported values: error_tracking, error_tracking_list, session_replay_list. Use dashboard-widget-catalog-list for config_schema_hints per type.
